name: pam_wheel
description: Allow only group members to su to root
detailed_description: Access control module that restricts privilege escalation to members of the wheel/sudo group. Prevents non-group users from using su to switch to other accounts. Common security practice for limiting administrative access.

parameters.use_uid: Use user ID instead of effective ID
parameters.trust: Don't prompt for password if user in wheel group

notes:
Restricts su access to members of wheel/sudo group
